messages.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
messages.text: Decision needed on unity_video_retarget. Since Jul 9 its CPI dropped from ~$1.15 to ~$0.50 on flat spend. Ingrid's analysis says it's invalid traffic: CTR ~5x, CVR halved, D1 of new installs ~15% vs ~34%, payer conversion less than half. Recommendation: (1) no budget increase, (2) fraud ticket with Unity + stricter Attributa Protect rule, (3) exclude the campaign from CPI benchmarks and install KPIs, (4) ask for makegoods.

replies.author: Marisol Okafor
replies.text: Agree with all four. Why not pause it outright?

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Revenue from the campaign hasn't changed, so the real users are still there and D7 ROAS is flat. Pausing loses those. If Unity can't clean it up we pause.

replies.author: Marisol Okafor
replies.text: OK. Approved. Please don't let the 'cheap CPI' land in any exec slides.
